title: Meesho Q2: Brokerages expect sustained revenue growth; profitability in focus as festive spending rises
summary: Meesho Q2: Brokerages expect sustained revenue growth; profitability in focus as festive spending rises
detailed: Bank of America expects revenue of Rs 4,130 crore and a net loss of Rs 141 crore for the quarter. Jefferies estimates revenue of Rs 4,064 crore and a pre-exceptional loss of Rs 155 crore, while Axis Capital forecasts revenue of Rs 4,072 crore and a net loss of Rs 127 crore.
